title: mris_ms_refine
description: This program positions the tessellation of the cortical surface at the white matter surface, then the gray matter surface. It generates surface files for these surfaces as well as a 'curvature' file for the cortical thickness, and a surface file which approximates layer IV of the cortical sheet.

omit_self_intersection.description: Omit self-intersection and only generate gray/white surface.
omit_self_intersection.title: Omit self-intersection flag

create_curvature_files.description: Create curvature and area files from white matter surface.
create_curvature_files.title: Create curvature files flag

average_curvature.description: Average curvature values a specified number of times.
average_curvature.title: Average curvature values
